Topics · The holy books together

What can Muslims, Jews and Christians agree on?

An invitation to a word on level ground: God alone, no human lords. The speaker steps on first; it stays free.

Part 1 of 3

﴿قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allāh and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allāh."[128] But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."

Translator's notes

[128] By obeying another in disobedience to Allāh.

Quran · Aal Imran 3:64

Translation

For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

Original · Hebrew

כִּֽי־אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ אֶל־עַמִּ֖ים שָׂפָ֣ה בְרוּרָ֑ה לִקְרֹ֤א כֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְעָבְד֖וֹ שְׁכֶ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃

Zephaniah · 3:9

World English Bible

When different people meet, each side usually starts with what is its own. This verse does the reverse, starting from what all can stand on. "Come", it says, literally rise together, to a word level between us and you. It holds three things: that we worship none but God, set no partner beside Him, and take no one among us as lords. Notice the pronoun: "we", "among us". The speaker stands under the word first. It is no condition imposed, but ground to which all are invited.

A question for you

Of the three things, which sounds nearest to what you learned at home?

If you sayWorship none but God
ThenThat is the ground every messenger carried, and you knew it from home.
If you sayNo human lords
ThenThat is shared ground: all authority belongs to God, for every community alike.
If you sayAll of them, in our own way
ThenThat is a good place to meet: what is shared, before what is one's own.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَلَا تُجَـٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُنَا وَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

Quran · Al-Ankabut 29:46

Translation

The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient, in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

Original · Ancient Greek

δοῦλον δὲ κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι, ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας, διδακτικόν, ἀνεξίκακον, ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους, μήποτε δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας,

2 Timothy · 2:24-25

World English Bible

How should people talk after such an invitation? The verse sets both manner and content. Manner: in the best way. Content: say we believe in what was sent to us and sent to you, and our God and your God is one. Before any discussion comes a sentence of faith that gathers. You are invited not to a quarrel but to a conversation that begins with what both believe. That is the common word in practice: each hears first that we believe in the one God.

A question for you

What sentence would you like to begin with, in talking to someone of another faith?

Part 3 of 3

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ٥١ وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ٥٢﴾

Translation of the meaning

[Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing. And indeed this, your religion, is one religion,[959] and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

Translator's notes

[959] See footnote to 21:92.

Quran · Al-Mu'minun 23:51-52

Translation

Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

Original · Hebrew

הֲל֨וֹא אָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ לְכֻלָּ֔נוּ הֲל֛וֹא אֵ֥ל אֶֽחָ֖ד בְּרָאָ֑נוּ מַדּ֗וּעַ נִבְגַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּאָחִ֔יו לְחַלֵּ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃

Malachi · 2:10

World English Bible

﴿وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ١١٨ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ١١٩﴾

Translation of the meaning

And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ, Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."

Quran · Hud 11:118-119

Where does this invitation lead? The first verses address the messengers: this nation of yours is one, and I am your Lord. The one nation is the prophets' nation, and the way back is for each person to join it by choice. The other verses set an honest limit: people will go on differing, except those on whom He has mercy. The Quran promises no united world. This is an invitation to each person, not a promised result. Mercy is the door that stays open.

A question for you

What makes this invitation worthwhile, if people will never all agree?

If you sayEach person chooses for themselves
ThenThat is what keeps it free, and it has a question of its own on no compulsion.
If you sayGod gathers people in the end
ThenThat is what 42:15 says. What remains is what we do before then.
If you sayI am not sure it is possible
ThenYou are not asked to know. It is enough to begin with your nearest neighbour.

The same in the other books

Translation

Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah. Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

Original · Hebrew

לָדַ֣עַת בָּאָ֣רֶץ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ בְּכָל־גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃ יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃ יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים ׀ בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃ יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

the Psalms · 67:2-5

If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land; but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.”
